scope: Focused primary-source methodological review; no new experiments or manuscript edits

sources.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
verified_findings: Fluency, correctness, and citation quality are distinct evaluated dimensions
Citation support is estimated through NLI
Automatic citation assessment was checked against human judgments
NLI limits include partial support
sources.implication: Use reference-aware answer judgment and separate context/citation support diagnostics
limits: Not a targeted-poisoning benchmark
Does not validate our numerical ASR rule
NLI entailment is fallible

sources.title: RAGAs: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
verified_findings: Faithfulness means claim support from supplied context
Answer relevance explicitly does not account for factuality
Evaluation prompts an LLM
WikiEval was built from 50 Wikipedia pages and used two annotators with disagreement discussion
sources.implication: Use as auxiliary context-support/relevance diagnostics; do not infer factual security from faithfulness alone
limits: A poisoned false context can support a false answer: this is our logical inference, not a RAGAs poisoning experiment
Human agreement on WikiEval does not validate our dataset
LLM judgment is not completed independent human review

sources.title: Survey Article: Inter-Coder Agreement for Computational Linguistics
consulted_sections: Sections on coefficient assumptions and annotator bias
verified_findings: Agreement is not sufficient to establish validity
Choice and interpretation of coefficient depend on coding assumptions and label distributions
sources.implication: Preserve independent labels, rubric, category counts, agreement, and adjudication separately; verify references independently
limits: No universal required number of reviewers, passing kappa, or sample size
Two annotators can share the same error

sources.title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
verified_findings: Distractor setting mixes two gold paragraphs with eight distractors
Answer, supporting-fact, and joint metrics are distinguished
Development and hidden test sets are separate
Additional human answers/support were collected to study ambiguity
sources.implication: Describe our numerical shared-corpus subset as a derived local external evaluation and retain original IDs/support mappings
limits: Our derived setting is not the official HotpotQA distractor or full-wiki benchmark
Does not prove no API-model pretraining contamination
Numeric occurrence is not proof of relation-level reference validity

sources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
sources.status: Published journal article; author preprint consulted
sources.access_note: Publisher DOI fetch returned 403; metadata checked on coauthor-institution publication record and relevant full preprint sections read
verified_findings: Proposes documenting dataset motivation, composition, collection, transformations, uses, distribution, maintenance
Explicitly asks about relationships, split rationale, sample representativeness, verification of derived data, and saved raw data/software
sources.implication: Maintain linked source/fact/chunk/question/reference/attack/result provenance and document missing historical assets
limits: Documentation does not authenticate sources or certify factual correctness
The framework requires adaptation to actual dataset/context

sources.title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science
sources.access_note: Publisher open returned 403; relevant full-text taxonomy content inspected through the primary PMC article's indexed record
verified_findings: Distinguishes byte-level/computational reproducibility from valid scientific analysis
Taxonomy addresses test-information access, preprocessing/selection, duplicates and mismatched scientific target distributions
sources.implication: Keep selection/tuning decisions separate from fresh output evaluation and make target distribution and overlap checks explicit
limits: Does not establish leakage in this study
Does not expose API pretraining data
Knowing target references for attack construction is not by itself training leakage

sources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Testing Statistical Significance in Natural Language Processing
sources.venue: Proceedings of ACL, Volume 1: Long Papers
verified_findings: Test selection depends on experimental setup and metric
Standard i.i.d. assumptions are often violated by NLP examples sharing sources/documents/authors
sources.implication: Declare paired/resampling units and distinguish frozen-corpus query summaries from new-corpus or fresh-generation uncertainty
limits: Does not certify the current bootstrap
Does not universally solve dependence or shared-index interference
Does not set the study's sample size/power

sources.title: Reporting Score Distributions Makes a Difference: Performance Study of LSTM-networks for Sequence Tagging
verified_findings: Single-run scores can conceal variation from random initialization/training
Advocates comparing distributions across actual executions
sources.implication: Separate attack-selection randomness and fresh generation repeats; cached duplicate rows are not independent draws
limits: Empirical setting is LSTM training, not API generation
Does not establish a required repeat count or variance for our LLM

sources.title: Show Your Work: Improved Reporting of Experimental Results
verified_findings: Reported model rankings can depend on tuning/search budgets
Proposes fuller reporting of search space, selection criteria, results and computation context
sources.implication: Preserve development decisions, failures, configuration selection, actual backend identity, and frozen-test separation
limits: Expected validation performance is not an ASR estimator
Reporting guidance does not mandate arbitrary extra experiments
